title: Mountains Scene 8 — Weather and Shelter
purpose: Weather changes, needs and simple cause/effect language.

sentenceModels: It is cold near the snow.
It is sunny on the left.

adultSupport.focus: Talk about what people or animals need when mountain weather changes.
starterPrompts: What might you need in cold weather?
expansionPrompts: Why would someone go to the hut?
What happens after the sunny weather changes?
